text:
He wished to sing, to sing
+
+so as to forget
+
+his true life made of lies
+
+and remember
+
+his lying life made of truths.

translation.title: Epitaph for a Poet
translation.editorial_note: The mirrored paradoxy of verdadera, mentiras, mentirosa, and verdades is kept structurally exact, with song suspended between forgetting and memory.
